line: ASUS Zenbook S16 OLED (2025/26, AMD Ryzen AI 300)
config_name: Zenbook S16 — Ryzen AI 7 445, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, 16" OLED touch

battery.notes: 63Wh (UX5606 chassis). Expect ~9-11h light use on the 16-inch OLED.

offers.name: ASUS Zenbook S16 16" Touchscreen AI PC Laptop - Scandinavian White (AMD Ryzen AI 7 445/16GB RAM/512GB SSD/Win11)

reviews.quote: a thin and light 16-inch laptop with a premium design, an OLED display, and AMD Ryzen AI hardware

praises: 16-inch OLED at under 1.5 kg — big screen without the usual 2 kg penalty
Strong BBY user rating (4.56/5 across 145 reviews)
Ceraluminum lid and slim profile look far more expensive than the sale price
Radeon 860M handles light gaming and video editing surprisingly well
Touchscreen OLED at this price is rare in 16-inch class
complaints: 63Wh battery is small for 16 inches — mid-pack runtime
16GB soldered RAM ceiling on this tier
Older 2025 chassis (pre-2026 S16 refresh) still mixed in retail stock

design_philosophy: ASUS's big-screen thin-and-light: 16-inch OLED in a ~1.5 kg Ceraluminum chassis aimed at users who want desktop real estate at ultrabook weight. This launch-gen AMD tier is now the value entry of the S16 family at deep Best Buy discount.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from Ultrabookreview Zenbook S16 (2025) review + sibling deltas; 16-inch OLED +1.5 screen_size vs the 14-inch anchors, −1.5 portability. BBY 4.56/5 (145 reviews) supports user-sentiment claims. UBR quote is from the S16 review index page (paraphrased descriptor), flagged for parent.
